Exercise: Leverage Chest Press

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- vertical_push

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- machine

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC and glycolytic

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- shoulder_and_triceps_strength
- chest_hypertrophy

Contraindications:

- Recent chest surgery
- Severe cardiovascular issues

Exercise Variations:

- name: Incline Leverage Chest Press, angle: 45 degrees
- name: Decline Leverage Chest Press, angle: 30 degrees

Substitution Options:

- name: Barbell Chest Press, equipment: barbell
- name: Dumbbell Chest Press, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the bottom or middle of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion.
- Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
- Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
- After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
